caption: The drawing features two representations of the same dress on a plain, light-colored background. On the left side, the dress is shown in a larger, more detailed depiction, rendered with alternating horizontal stripes in muted pink and white with subtle shading. The dress has short puffed sleeves, a fitted bodice with a wide neckline, and a full skirt with multiple tiered ruffles that extend to the floor. The ruffles are defined with detailed line work combined with the pink color. To the right and slightly above the larger dress, there is a smaller, simpler line drawing of the same dress, showing only black outlines without any color or shading, emphasizing the tiered construction and general shape. The artist’s signature is present near the smaller drawing on the right. There are no other objects or markings on the otherwise empty background.
title: Dress
